Package com.example

Class Board

java.lang.Object
com.example.Board
Direct Known Subclasses:
ChaosBoard, FilledBoard, YinBoard
public class Board extends Object
The Board class represents a game board consisting of squares and pawns. It supports creating a board with specified dimensions and managing its state.
